name: @singularity/plugin-apps-sonata-rich-key-readout
description: Sonata Section: the current key — its name, relative key and source, the scale as dots on a two-octave readout keyboard plus note-name chips, and (Chords toggle) its seven diatonic chords as the chord list's rows (chord box + lit keyboard + how often the song plays its root, click to play) — tracking the playback cursor.
